About Meridian Industrial Group

Meridian Industrial Group was founded in Sydney in 1962 as a pump repair workshop and is headquartered in Sydney at 100 George Street. It has been listed on the Australian Securities Exchange since 1987 and today employs 12,400 people across 22 manufacturing plants and 60 service centres in 14 countries.

Leadership

  • Helena Marsh, Chief Executive Officer and Managing Director
  • Rajesh Iyer, Chief Financial Officer
  • Grace Whitlam, Chair of the Board

Headquarters

Meridian Industrial Group Limited, Level 12, 100 George Street, Sydney NSW 2000, Australia.

History

1962: founded as Meridian Pumps in Marrickville. 1987: listed on the ASX. 2004: acquired Delta Valve Systems and entered energy. 2016: formed Meridian Infrastructure. Today: three businesses, 14 countries.
